body.name: elimTok
body.def: A token \(\ell=(\operatorname{op},\tau,L,Z)\) has \(\operatorname{op}\in\{\operatorname{ancestor},\operatorname{augment},\operatorname{district},\operatorname{terminal}\}\), names the current task \(\tau\), and records the nonempty vertex set or ordered kernel labels computed by that case. District children and terminal factors are stored in canonical input order.
